Phenophase.reasoning: The column describes the biological developmental stage (phenophase) of the organism.

Year variance.reasoning: This header defines the statistical property (variance) measured across years.

Site variance.reasoning: This header defines the statistical property (variance) measured across sampling sites.

Species variance.reasoning: This header defines the statistical property (variance) measured across species.

Residual variance.reasoning: This header defines the statistical property (residual variance) measured in the model.
